title: CDN Caching
definition: CDNs sit between the user and the origin server. They cache responses closer to the user geographically. CDN caching is controlled via `s-maxage` or edge-specific rules.
simpleExplanation: A massive global hard drive that stores your website so people in Australia don't have to wait for the data to travel from your server in New York.
